title: Squarespace Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Squarespace has the best-looking templates in its category, but it falls short on SEO control, backend depth, and portability. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Squarespace's core gaps natively, full SEO control plus a built-in fix instead of a locked robots.txt and sitemap, a real backend instead of content-only, and full portability instead of a design that stays locked to one platform, and it's a more complete platform overall: growth tooling, agentic AI features, and human support are all things Squarespace doesn't offer. More options are compared in our[Squarespace alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/best-squarespace-alternatives) guide.
